origin.origins.human.description:
§l§nOverview§r: 
Ta staydyn dooinney ny s'foshlit na'n chooid smoo - gow rish gyn soylley ny s'leaie.
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.name: Alfiq
origin.medievalorigins.alfiq.description:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Bonus gyn armey§r
§o§2+ Ghluaise Unnaneysit§r
§o§6• Carnivoor§r
§o§c- Dioney§r
§lAlfiq§r ta'n ghlen-chynney anthropomorphic lesh clawnyn sharpey as ard-chleaysh.Ta ny raaidyn oc goaill stiagh gainney glen.
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.name: Archnae;
origin.medievalorigins.arachnae.descript:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Poison, Riaghlagh y phobble
+ Cliaghtey Ballagh§r
§o§6• Carnivoor§r
§o§c- Accrys, Armour§r
Co-cheangal grotesque jeh spider as dooinney, lesh sniaghtey venomous as trooid bristled agh y ghraih dy gholl stiagh as dy ghraih armey.
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.name: Banshee;
origin.medievalorigins.banshee.descripti:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Flight, Tastey, Phasing§r
§o§6• Neu-marroo
§o§c- Dioney§r
§o§c- Caghlaaghyn ard, leigh y chied cheayrt!§r
§lBansheeyn;§r ta spyrrydyn agglagh as t’ad ymmyrkey glass as ymmyrkey dooinney gys mraane.Ayns myth, t'ad ry-akin dy mennick myr omen baase.
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.name: Incubus
origin.medievalorigins.incubus.descripti:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Bonusyn Nether
§o§6• Bunait er-y-feaysley
§o§c- Dammaged liorish Ushtey§r
§o§c- Lag ayns Overworld§r
§lIncubi§r ta drogh sharvaantyn pooar dorragh.Ta ad cummaltagh ayns nyn reeaghyn hene, agh ayns cochiangle rish shoh t’ad er choyrt seose nyn annym, as t’ad lag da fondaghyn glen.
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.name: Nano
origin.medievalorigins.dwarf.description:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Maghyn, Caving§r
§o§6• Gearr: 102cm.3'7"§r
§o§c- Tushtagh rish y ghrian 
- Cha vod mee snaue§r
§lNane§r ta pragmatagh, stockagh, as boght.Ta'n ghrian ry-akin as ry-akin fo'n talloo, agh t'ad ry-chlashtyn rish soilshey y lae.Creg as creg, braar.
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.name: Elf Cooidjagh
origin.medievalorigins.wood_elf.descript:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Bonussyn Ranged, Lught§r
§o§6• Goal, Vegetarian§r
§o§c- Dioney§r
§lElfyn Cooidjagh§r ta race glen, ard-bea, as t’ad beaghey ayns coardailys rish y Talloo.Ta ad sniessey lesh clagh as boggey as t'ad able dy ghraihaghey nyn noidyn tra t'ad mastey ny craaghyn.
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.name: Elf Ard
origin.medievalorigins.high_elf.descript:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Magic, Cooishyn Unnaneysit§r
§o§c- Daggey Corporal
- Dioney§r
§lElfyn Ard§r son arrogant, agh dy bragh talentagh;t'ad ry-hoi ry-hoi trooid nyn fuill, agh t'ad ny lajer lesh armey.
origin.medievalorigins.fae.name: Fae
origin.medievalorigins.fae.description:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Hover, Magic§r
§o§6• Gearr: 122cm.4'0"§r
§o§c- Graigh ec Mobs§r
§lFae§r ta crooaghyn coshee magic ta elegance, infused lesh magic najooragh as ceaut dy doaltattym rish ny coaryssyn veih ta ad cheet.
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.name: Goblin;
origin.medievalorigins.goblin.descriptio:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Bonussyn Gear Oor§r
§o§2+ Force, Lught§r 
§o§6• Beg: 92cm.3'3"§r 
§o§c- Slaynt, Dioney§r
§lGoblinyn§r ta obsessed lesh oor as treishteil as t'ad tendeil dy gheddyn beggan ny smoo loot c'raad erbee ta'd shooyl, agh ta'n aght beg oc jannoo ad vulnerable ayns combaase.
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.name: Gorgon;
origin.medievalorigins.gorgon.descriptio:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Caghlaa Poison, Immunity§r
§o§2+ Smaght y phobble§r
§o§c- Ushtaghyn 
- Lagaghyn un-ghooghyssagh§r
§lGorgoonyn§r ta crooaghyn mallaghtagh v’erreish da ve dooinney, lesh ghruaie jeant jeh naightyn shliaghtey as visage s’goanney t’er ny ghra dy vel eh petrify adsyn ta fakin eh.
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.name: Elf Geay
origin.medievalorigins.moon_elf.descript:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Dagger Dagger
+ Smooinee§r
§o§6• Stealthy, Cha nel eh coodaghey§r
§o§c- Dioney§r
Beaaghyn mysterious, ethereal nagh vel jeh'n theihll shoh.Cha nel elfyn-gheay enmyssit son nyn ard-valley, agh son y red ayn ta nyn 'victims' ry-akin roish nyn jerrey.
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.name: Ogre
origin.medievalorigins.ogre.description:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Bonussyn Axe, Dioney §r
§o§6• Mooar: 268cm.9'5"§r
§o§c- Accrys, Lught §r
§lOgreyn§r ta'n 'Orc' ny 'subspecies' mooar, gearr-chreeagh, as brutish.Ta'n lumbering size oc as y ghraih beg oc jeant magh liorish nyn neart cruin.
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.name: Pixie
origin.medievalorigins.pixie.description:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Flight Unnaneysit, Odd§r
§o§6• Beg: 22cm.9" §r
§o§c- Dymmollagh, Cliaghtey §r
T'ad dy mennick er nyn goyrt myr harbingeryn jeh fortune, agh myrgeddin obbreeyn tricky, neu-feoilt.Ta Pixies glen as glen, glen.
origin.medievalorigins.plague_victim.des:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Creeaght §r
§o§6• Style cloie ymmyrchagh §r
§o§6• Neu-marroo §r
§o§c- Dymmollagh, Cliaghtey 
§o§c- Condragh§r
Cretooryn lesh gleashtanyn lesh gleashtanyn nagh vod ad ve enmyssit dooinney, mallaght as glennit ayns y vioys dy bragh farraghtyn myr thooill y gleashtan s’diuney.
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.name: Revenant
origin.medievalorigins.revenant.descript:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Gairm §r
§o§2+ Illager Chaarjagh 
§o§6• Neu-marroo, Complex §r
§o§c- Ambee
- Eaddagh beo §r
§lRevenantyn§r ta anmeenyn mee-chrauee v’er marroo baaseyn glen as pianagh, agh v’ad er nyn rheynn reesht gys bea.Mar y toshiaght, t'ad obsessed lesh manipulate bea as baase ayns crooaghyn elley.
origin.medievalorigins.siren.name: Siren;
origin.medievalorigins.siren.description:
§l§nOverview§r: T'eh er ny ghra dy vel 
§o§2+ Ushtey, Utility §r
§o§6• Ny lajer er Talloo §r
§o§c- Vulnerable da'n aile §r
§lSirens§r t'ad er n'insh dy velTa aura ensnaring oc as t'eh er ny ghra dy vel nyn ghloyr gyn-ymmyd y fallshaghey jeh ymmodee marrey foolish.
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.name: Yeti;
origin.medievalorigins.yeti.description:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Bun-reayrt, Tanky§r
§o§6• Mooar: 203cm.6'8"§r
§o§c- Tushtey da'n Teas§r
Beastyn three-feed jeh coadyn fliugh, ta reill Yeti er ice lesh ad dy reayll nagh vel ad ry-gheddyn, agh t'ad ard-vooaralagh da ionnsyn t'ad ry-gheddyn.
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.name: Valkyrie;
origin.medievalorigins.valkyrie.descript:
§l§nArd-scrutaght§r: 
§o§2+ Slaynt§r 
§o§6• Skeeanyn lesh cliaghtey§r 
§o§c- Lag gys Undead§r
§lValkyrie;§r ta cowreyderyn skianagh fegooish aggle ta cur stiagh y stayd jeh’n lught-thie ayns caggey;v'ad er n'insh dy row ad er chur ny marroo gys Valhalla Odin
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.name: Clawed
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.clawed.descr: Alfiq t'ad clawsyn ry-cheilley rish razor;T'ad jannoo daghnys ec y traa t'ayn, as t'ad uss cliaghtey seose as cliaghtey rish ushtaghyn steep (Foddee ad toggled)
Tra t'eh er n'gholl sheese as t'eh er n'eiyrt, t'Alfiq glenney as ymmyrkey mooar ny s'giare.Ayns traa elley, t'ad lethargic as beggan ny sloo.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.on_your_feet: As, tra t'ou uss ry-lane, ta shiu jeeaghyn dy kiart sheese, ny gow dagh red jeh'n tuittym.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pickpocket.d: Click-jee er y dhrogh-chree jeh dooinney-balley tra t'eh croymmey lesh laueyn foshlit son cochiangle dy ghoaill smaragdyn.Or dy ve er ny ghlackey.Rumor t'eh dy vod oo goaill rish clowanyn elley.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.name: Pounce;
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.pounce.descr: As lurg crouching gorrym gyn glenney dy chargey, t'Alfiq ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi.As t'eh streeu rish y pounce, t'eh jannoo dagh bonus.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.poor_grip.de: Alfiq t'ad er n'yannoo ymmyd jeh breaking speed lesh ymmyd as t'ad er n'yannoo ymmyd jeh armeyn handled myr clashtyn as axes.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.agile_prefer: Ta Alfiq s'goaill rish armouryn light ny lomarcan son y ghluaise.Faggys da armouryn trome ve glennit gyn peccah lesh enchantment.
power.medievalorigins.alfiq.meow.name: Meow;
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.bottomles: Ta Arachnae feme er mraane billey son dy chummal beo.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.brittle.d: Ta'n exoskeleton chitinous jeh'n Arachnae jannoo eh doaltattym dy ghleashaghey my ta'n armour ny s'trome na'n iarn.Ta shen ry-hoilley lesh enchantment.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.climber.d: Ta ny bristlyn fine er cosh ny Arachnae cur lhieu ad dy hroggal seose mullagh.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.fragile_e: Ta'n exoskeleton jeh'n Arachnae ny s'leaie son stroo.Ta beggan ny sloo slaynt oc na dooinney regular.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.many_eyes: Ta'n ocht sooillyn jeh'n Arachnae ooilley adpated gys dorraghys, as t'ad cur lhieu ad dy akin soilley agh lesh beggan soilshey.
power.medievalorigins.arachnae.venomous_: Ta vein ayns sniaghtey Arachnae, as ta cochiangle ec gagh ionnsagh dy chur poison.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.spectral.d: Ta'n cochiangle ec banshees dy ve neu-ghooghyssagh, glenney s'leaie trooid y physical realm tra nagh vod ad ymmyd y yannoo jeh.Ta shoh usaghey ard-energy as cha nel eh ry-obbraghey tra ta'n accrys low.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.name: Hexed
power.medievalorigins.banshee.hexed.desc: Banshees t'ad cloie ayns mallaghyn.Gagh traa t’ad er nyn stroie, ta’n chaslys beg dy bee’n strooan er ny choyrt gys baase slow, agonizing.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.immaterial: Ta'n banshees lesh leshtal y slaynt veagh ec dooinney beo.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.dimeritium: Ta metallyn s'maghrey, myr sampleyr, iarn ny argid, dy bragh neu-ghooghyssagh da banshees.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.lunar_nexu: Cha nel banshees ry-gheddyn accrys erbee jeh'n vee - cha nel nyn nerve ry-gheddyn agh liorish soilshey y gheay direct, agh cha nel ad ry-gheddyn accrys.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.sonic_shri: Screeuyn Banshee t'ad cur raad er baase.Faggys da'n ghrian 'sy ghrian 'sy ghrian, 'sy ghrian 'sy ghrian, 'sy ghrian 'sy ghrian 'sy ghrian, as 'sy ghrian 'sy ghrian 'sy ghrian.Targetyn ta er nyn stroie dy jeeragh liorish y shliaghtey, bee ad er nyn stroie
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_sig: Ta shiu jannoo mraane daghnys tra ta shiu uss arm cursed.
power.medievalorigins.banshee.cursed_war: Ta shiu streeu rish dagh red t'er ny ghleie son gagh p'art armor cursed t'er ny ghleie.
Ta fuill incubus gyn shee.As mannagh vel eh feoh bea, cha nel eh ymmyrchagh.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.demon_fire: Ta Incubi innately ny smoo pooaral lesh ooilley ny magicsyn aile, as t'ad uss 'sy ghraih 'sy ghraih.Scales lesh Pooar Spell Fee.
Ta'n aile myr thie - cha nel eh jannoo dagh red da Incubi as t'eh satiate ad.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.hydrophobe: Ta'n ushtey scald Incubi, as t'eh jannoo daggey orroo tra t'ad ry-cheilley.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.impure.des: Incubi t'ad ymmyrkey daghnys ec Smite as t'ad ymmyrkey effeityn veih slaynt as daghnys.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.dimension_: Cha nel Incubi cliaghtey rish dimensionyn raad ta'n ghraih sheeyney as t'ad ny lajer shen, agh t'ad ny s'creeney 'sy Nether.
power.medievalorigins.incubus.unholy_dea: Faggys da incubus cuid jeh'n nerve bea oc y chaghlaa son cummey glen son traa ghorney.Triggerit lesh y key Active Bun-Troggalys.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.darkness_dwe: Losht soilshey y ghrian direct sooillyn dwarf, dallaghey ad son y traa.Preventable lesh enchantment ny helmet oor.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.name: Dynney
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dense.descri: Ta ny dwarfyn ard-trome son nyn mess;t'ad shleaystey dy hrooid ayns ushtey.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.dwarven_tech: Ta dwarfs ry-hoi ymmyrkey cloie gyn pickaxe, as ymmyrkey red erbee ny s'faggys da feallagh elley.
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.miniature.de: Ta ny dwarfyn ry-gheddyn ry-gheddyn ayns tunnel 1 metre er yrjid (as cha nel ad cho leah as un).
power.medievalorigins.dwarf.nocturnal_ey: Faggys dwarfyn focus dy akin soilshey gyn feme erbee jeh soilshey.
Ta dwarves cliaghtey son ny deoiryn cummaltagh oc as ymmyd y yannoo jeh dooinney daa cheayrt ny smoo na ad.Activate dy ghoaill swig as dy hroggal slaynt reesht.
Cha nel ymmyd erbee ec dooinney jeh'n chleaysh bun.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.archer.de: Ta Elfyn Cooidjagh caghlaa yn vea oc ooilley dy h-ynsee rish boughyn - ta ny saighdyn oc dagh ooilley traa ny s'marroo.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.forest_vi: Tra t'ad ayns shrubbery ard ny duillagyn, t'ad elfyn coodaghey crouch dy gheddyn vision 'sy noid as dy ve neu-ghooghyssagh da mobbyn ry-hoi.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.eagle_eye: Faggys Wood Elves ry-cheilley rish y ghraih son y traa ghorney erreish daue y stroie, eddyr y traa nagh vel ad ayns y sight.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.empowered: As lurg chargey bow son beggan secoondyn, scarrey saighdeyr lesh velocity as precision s'meshagh dy fliaghey s'faggys as s'true, as s'faggys da 2 nagh row.
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.elegant.d: Ta Elfyn Cooidjagh ny sloo slaynt as t'ad slowaghey liorish ymmyd y yannoo jeh armor trome (Ta'n red shoh ry-ghoaill rish enchantment).
power.medievalorigins.wood_elf.steward.d: Ta elfyn cowrey beaghey jeh as ayns harmony y choadey - Cha vod ad feoh y ghleiy.
Ta elfyn cowrey beggan ny s'ardjey na'n dooinney glen.
Cha nel elfyn cowrey cho cummaltagh, agh t'ad s'leshtal.Ta ny h-attackyn eu jannoo dagh red agh t'ad beggan ny s'fast.
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.name: Allure
power.medievalorigins.fae.allure.descrip: Fae t'ad s'natural.Mobs hed ad er-gerrey veih mooar ny s’faggys da cretooryn elley.
power.medievalorigins.fae.diminutive.des: Ta Fae goaill stiagh, as y chooid smoo jeu cha nel ad ny s'ardjey na'n goblin 'sy 'mean.'
Iarn as airh t'ad ymmyrkey cummeydyn fae.Ta’n red shen neu-ghooghyssagh daue dy ghleie eh.
power.medievalorigins.fae.levitation.des: Ta Fae crooaghyn light, winged as t'ad ry-flooit gyn streeu er an aer.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_blessi: Channel energies bea potent son ymmyd gearr.As t'ou glan, spread siyn er thalloo-feeyney stepped-on as pulse slaynt as glane-energie gys allies ry-cheilley.
power.medievalorigins.fae.nourishment.de: Scapail burst dy nerve bea, fertilizing plantyn dy h-oikoil ayns sthie mygeayrt oo.
power.medievalorigins.fae.forest_kin.des: As t’ou ayns brasnaghey coayl, ta dty loghtyn ry-gheddyn ny s’faggys da.
power.medievalorigins.fae.natures_ward.d: Ta shiu ceaut rish nature, as t'eh cur immunity da poison as nausea, as resistance da ymmyd magic.
power.medievalorigins.fae.reduced_health: Ta Fae crooaghyn s'delicate lesh ny sloo slaynt na dooinney.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.cunning.des: Ta Goblins cretooryn clean, as ta fys oc c'raad t'ad geddyn loot ny s'anmey nagh row y chooid smoo dy leih elley er n'yannoo.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.name: Frail;
power.medievalorigins.goblin.frail.descr: Son y stature beg oc, ta ny sloo slaynt ec goblins' as t'ad ny smoo glen.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.name: Ghooinney.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.greedy.desc: Ta co-cheangal s'speciale ec Goblins rish treasure - t'ad geddyn bonussyn ec y traa t'ad uss uss ny uss geddyn uss.
Ta'n airh ayns laueyn goblin geddyn stiagh son mooar ny s'hickyr na'n chooid smoo dy leih elley ta neu-ghooghyssagh rish.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.name: Nish.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.nippy.descr: C'raad as dy vel ad gearr, ta goblinyn ry-hoi ry-hoi, as t'ad ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi.
power.medievalorigins.goblin.stunted.des: Ta Goblins glen, ec ny sloo na leth ard-chree dooinney.
Gorgons cha vod ad glenney y ushtey as goaill daghnys veih.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.to_stone.de: Va Gorgonyn dooghyssagh dy chummal ceaut ayns ushtaghyn dorragh as sean-dungeonyn.As t’ad er-mayrn ayns soilshey y laa, t’ad geddyn petrified derrey’n oie.Faggys da'n helmet y ghleiy.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.silver_aver: Gorgons t'ad lag da glenney argid - cha vod ad seasagh dy ghleie eh as dy ghoaill daghnys tra t'ad y ghleie.(Ta'n iarn coontit myr argid myrgeddin)
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.petrifying_: Ta mee er n’yannoo rish sooillyn mob erbee ta ry-hoi, as t’ad er nyn ghlenney gys clogh son y chooid smoo.Cha nel eh obbraghey er bosses.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.poison_bloo: Ta gorgonyn immune da poison, as ta cochiangle oc dy scughey nyn fuill toxicagh er ny nagh row ry-cheilley tra t'ad er nyn stroie, as t'ad poisonit.
power.medievalorigins.gorgon.revenge.des: Gorgons t'ad jannoo dagh red s'meshagh ec slaynt low.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.elegant.d: Ta Elfyn Ard slowaghey liorish ymmyd y yannoo jeh armor trome (Ta'n red shoh ry-ghoaill rish enchantment), as ta'n slaynt oc ny sloo.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.ebonbreat: Trooid ymmyd jeh niartyn difrinagh, t'eh ry-hoi elfyn ard y nerve y red y chur magh dy scarrey magics difrinagh.Hover er gagh box dy akin fys.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.fragile.d: Cha nel High Elf er ny thooilley son combaase laue rish laue.Ta ad foddey smoo glen jeh daghnys corpagh, as ta ny smoo slaynt oc.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mystic_af: Ta Elfyn Ard cummaltagh as cliaghtey manipulatoryn arcane energy - t'ad jannoo ny smoo daghnys 'sy ghraih as t'ad goaill ny smoo 'sy ghraih 'sy ghraih na raceyn elley.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_rpgm: Ta ny Elfyn Uchtagh ry-gheddyn ny smoo mana na raceyn elley, as t'ad ry-gheddyn pooar nyn elderyn dy ath-chroo mana dy h-earroo.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: Ta ny Elfyn Uchtagh ry-gheddyn ny smoo mana na raceyn elley, as t'ad ry-gheddyn pooar nyn elderyn dy ath-chroo mana dy h-earroo.
Ta ny Elfyn Uchtagh ry-gheddyn ny smoo mana na raceyn elley, as t'ad ry-gheddyn pooar nyn elderyn dy ath-chroo mana dy h-earroo.
power.medievalorigins.high_elf.mana_iron: Ta ny Elfyn Uchtagh ry-gheddyn ny smoo mana na raceyn elley, as t'ad ry-gheddyn pooar nyn elderyn dy ath-chroo mana dy h-earroo.
Ta Elfyn Ard slane as beggan ny s'ardjey na'n dooinney glen.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.crazed.de: Feayrish as might ad, cha vod Elfyn Geay coodaghey 'sy 'overworld'.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.stealth.d: Ayns y dorraghys, t'ad Moon Elves ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi, as ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi.Nush t'ad ymmyrkey jeh stealth, t'ad ymmyrkey bonus damage as t'ad cur jerrey da'n invisibility.Ta shoh jannoo daghnys ec y traa t'ayn.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.elegant.d: Ta Moon Elves slowaghey liorish ymmyd y yannoo jeh armour trome.Ta shen ry-hoilley lesh enchantment.
Ta elfyn geayltyn tannagh as fiu beggan threealtagh, as ta rang ghorghys ec y chrackan oc.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.fragile.d: Ta Moon Elves er n'yannoo slaynt as t'ad er n'yannoo mraane corporal.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.moonlight: Ta Moon Elves ny s'efficient 'sy ghraih arm light as 'sy ghraih.T'ad jannoo ny smoo daghnys lesh daggeryn as knives.
power.medievalorigins.moon_elf.nimble.de: Lesh ny reflexsyn s'leshtal oc, ta Moon Elves ry-gheddyn cochiangle beg dy s'leshtal.
Ta Elfyn Geay mysh yr un ard-chree as nyn ghareydyn foddey jeh'n choayl, as shen t'ad jannoo beggan ny s'ardjey na'n dooinney.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.gargantuan.de: Ta Ogres massagh, as cha vod ad geddyn trooid dorryssanyn ny son y chooid smoo ayns ymmodee strughtooryn beggey.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.lead_belly.de: Ogres cha nel ad cur ymmyd jeh'n red ta'd ymmyrkey.Bieys y veeal.Cha vel ad geddyn poison ny accrys.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.name: Ravenous
power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravenous.desc: Ogres cha nel ad ry-hoi ry-hoi;ta feme orroo dy ee ry-cheilley dy kinjagh dy ve satisfied.'

power.medievalorigins.ogre.ravager.descr: Axes t'eh ry-akin ayns laue Ogre;t'eh y comfort shoh cur lhieu dy swing lesh mooar ny smoo force.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.bloodlust.des: Ta'n Ogres ainjyssagh dy fliaghey ayns rage dall, raad t'ad able dy stomp trooid horde dy nagh row ry-hoi agh cha nel ad able dy ghra cre ta goll er mygeayrt orroo.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.name: Smooinaghtagh.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.sluggish.desc: Ta Ogres ny sloo na'n chooid smoo, dy chosney cuid jeh'n nerve oc dys geddyn stiagh 'sy mhean oc.
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.name: Stockagh
power.medievalorigins.ogre.stocky.descri: Ta craidey three-feed as crampyn three-feed Ogres jannoo jeu dy vod ad tankyn mooarane ny smoo hits na feallagh elley.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.curse_of_fli: Cha vod Pixies chestplates ny s'substansiagh y chosney na lesh, as cha vod ad skianyn elley y usaghey dy h-earroo dy h-earroo.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.feather_foot: Pixies t'ad cho light, cha nel eh possible daue dy ghoaill fall damage.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.name: Er ny Dustyn
power.medievalorigins.pixie.flight.descr:
Faggys da pixies fliaghey as stiurey ad hene er-ash as sheese.
Leigh ny bocsanyn ta ry-cheilley rish y phooar shoh son stiurey mychione myr dy fliaghey.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.name: Giare;
power.medievalorigins.pixie.mount.descri: Ta'n 'right click' orroo lesh laueyn foshlit.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.good_fortune: C'raad as dy vod pixies ve trome, t'ad co-cheangailt rish slaynt.Nush t'ad jannoo myn, t'ad ry-gheddyn red valubale jeh cloie plain.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.pixie_proper: Ta Pixies cuid jeh'n cretooryn smoo 'sy thalloo, as cha nel ad ry-gheddyn 'sy ghlinney 'sy ghlinney 'sy ghlinney 'sy ghlinney.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.name: Foddey
power.medievalorigins.pixie.soaked.descr: As t'ad cho beg as t'ad, t'ushtey ny threishteil mooar da pixies.T'eh cur stayd da'n ghluaise oc as t'eh cur stayd da'n aght dy heet.
power.medievalorigins.pixie.troublemaker: Ta'n pobble 'sy valley goaill rish pixies liorish ny s'cosoylagh rish ny s'cosoylagh rish, as bee ad disobey dy 'trade' roo.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.cont: Ta ny Plagued nyn sight scanshoil.Ta'n pobble 'sy valley dy ghra dy vel ad er n'yannoo trade roo son aggle.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.foul: Ta ard-chreeagh swarm y victim, as t'eh s'leaie y ghleiy bea dy chooilley ghooinney ta beaghey ry-cheilley.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.inso: Ta coodaghey neu-ghooghyssagh da'n Plagued, er y fa dy vel ad gyn jerrey.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.plag: C'raad nagh vel y pian immense er-dy-henney, cha nel agh choud as tissue y vod marroo.Ta carryn immune rish poison as t'ad shleaystey.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.eter: As lurg 5 minuteyn, tra t'ad marroo, t'ad y Plagued er nyn goyrt beo dy h-earroo dy h-earroo nyn torment.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.risk: Gagh traa t'ou strike, ta cochiangle dy spread y vioys.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.sens: Ta ny Plagued cloie rish slystyn as slystaghyn er y chrackan, t'ad glen as pianagh dy ghra.Cha vod e victimyn armour y chosney son y pian ta’n vioys echey.
power.medievalorigins.plague_victim.skin: Ta’n chingys shoh drain y spyrryd, as t’eh cowraghey slaynt as speed y skeaylley.
power.medievalorigins.siren.amphibious.d: Ayns ushtey ta sirenyn ry-anmey as ry-chasley myr t'ad ry-anmey, ry-fakin dy foshlit, as t'ad ry-snaue lesh speed s'meshagh.
power.medievalorigins.siren.flammable.de: Sirenyn as aile cha nel ad mestit.Jeh'n aght ta'n flam ry-gheddyn, bee eh ry-gheddyn baase ry-gheddyn.
power.medievalorigins.siren.holy_water.d: Ta corp ath-chruinnaghey mooar ny s'giare ec sirenyn, agh agh tra t'ad ry-hoi ry-hoi.
power.medievalorigins.siren.out_of_your_: Tra t'ad er thalloo, cha vod Sirens agh slaynt ny ath-chroo liorish uss potions.
power.medievalorigins.siren.siren_song.d: Activate dy ghleiy nagh row ry-gheddyn ayns sthie mooar, as dy row ad ry-gheddyn rish y traa shoh.Cha nel eh obbree er bosses ny clowanyn.
power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.name: Taitnyssagh
power.medievalorigins.siren.seduce.descr: Press y key active secondary dy gheddyn favour rish villager as dy gheddyn trades ny share jeu.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.flammable.des: Ta Yetis boggyssagh da daghnys jeh'n aile er y fa dy vel ad 'sy gheimmey.
Yeti t'eh able dy hroggal nagh row ry-cheilley ayns ice er comandant.Nish t'eh obbree ayns y nether ny er bosses.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.from_whence_y: Er biomeyn reayrt, t'ad yetis glenney ny s'fast as t'ad n'eiyrt rish daghnys tuittym.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.frosty_breath: Ta'n annym frosty jeh'n yeti slowaghey dagh adversary ta cheet stiagh roo.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.thick_fur.des: Ayns ny h-ashoonyn, ta'n fur three-feed myr mallaght - t'eh cur stiagh gluaise Yetis as t'eh luggey slaynt
power.medievalorigins.yeti.titanic.name: Titanic;

power.medievalorigins.yeti.unstoppable.d: Yetis t'ad immune rish y slaynt.
power.medievalorigins.yeti.winter_body.d: Ta Yetis beggan ny s'ardjey na dooinney ry-hoi, as ny s'leaie.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.command_s: Command da dty undead combaase (cha nee marrey) er nyn goyrt dy leih, dy suitch, ny dy teleportaghey hood.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.black_thu: Cha vod Revenant geddyn red erbee;t'ad wilt rish nyn 'touch' marvaanagh.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.disturbed: Experimentaghey ayns y toshiaght warps yn innid.Cha vod Revenants coodaghey, ro-chreeagh dy bhuinnaghey ny ta’d booiagh nagh row ad er hoiggal.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.hellraise: As e toilchinys, t'eh ry-hoi y revenant y hroggal skeletonyn inert, as t'eh obbraghey myr skian t'er-dy-hoshiaght dy choadey ad veih danger as dy stroie ny nagh row ry-hoi.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.unwithera: Ta Revenants immune da shliaghtey, as, myr undead, t'ad goaill dagh red jeh smite, t'ad geddyn effeityn inverted jeh effeityn shliaghtey as slaynt, as t'ad immune da effeityn poison as ath-nuggeaght.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.putrid_co:
Trooid y ghraih unsettling dy ghleiy flesh ny crampyn ny undead, t'eh ry-hoi ymmyrkey cummey da'n summon ec y jerrey jeh'n un seihll.
Foddey crooaghyn cogaidh, slaraghey yn traa oc, as jean ad permanent ec y phooar smoo.Son steeds undead, ymmyrkey yn aght oc ec cummey max.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.skeleton_: Faggys da Revenants ath-thooilley crooaghyn y noidyn ry-chasley dy yannoo nyn bidding hene.Ta'n red shoh obbraghey myr pets, bee ad lesh as teleport, as t'ad ry-gheddyn armey ny armor.Zombies cha vod ad boggey y usaghey.Hover ny badjyn son fys.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.poor_repu: Ta'n pobble 'sy valley dy ghra dy vel ad er n'yannoo trade rish revenants as ta golems iarain ry-hoi 'sy sight.Agh, t'ad er nyn goaill stiagh (tenuously) ec Pillagers.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.siphon.de: Nush t'ad er nyn stroie, ta revenants ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi ry-hoi.Ta shoh goaill toshiaght er ooilley ny cretooryn son ny share ny ny sloo, agh summon dead.
power.medievalorigins.revenant.unguarded: Ta obsession er y reeaght spyrrydoil jannoo revenants ny smoo foshlit da ymmyd 'sy reeaght corporal.Ta'n chooid smoo jeh mobbyn jannoo ny smoo daghnys daue.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.wings.des: Ta skianyn mooarey lesh cliaghtey geal ec Valkyrie, as t'ad ry-hoi ry-hoi.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.intervent:
Leap seose gys an aer ny dash er-ash ma t'ou er-e-skyn, as gow immunity fall derrey t'ou uss ry-lane.

Tra t'ou er n'immeeaght ny erreish da 10 secondyn, sniee yn ard-valley lesh y nerve casherick, glane effeityn negative jeh'n allies ta ry-cheilley as leigheil ad, as pushtal non-allies ry-cheilley.Scaalaghyn slaynt lesh cummey spell slaynt.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.divine_sm: Gagh treeoo ionnsagh, smite foes ry-cheilley.Scaalyn daghnys lesh cummey spell slaynt.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.corruptio: Mobs undead ta ry-cheilley t'ad uss y ghleiy as uss y ghleiy, as ta'n ionnsagh oc jannoo ny smoo daghnys dhyt.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.vanquishe: Tra t'ou marroo mob undead, cur §nDivine Smite§r§r§r as luggey beggan effeityn §nCorruption§r son gagh marroo.Loss lesh stackyn er baase.
power.medievalorigins.valkyrie.heavenly_: Ta Valkyrie ry-gheddyn ny smoo cummey spell slaynt as t'ad ny smoo pooaral lesh armeyn lance ny spear.

enchantment.medievalorigins.mirroring.de: Lesh y ghraih shoh er ny choyrt gys helmetyn, ta clowanyn immune da sight petrifying Gorgon as t'eh ry-akin ec Dwarves myr t'eh ry-akin ayns soilshey y lae.
